data.name: Renewing Radiance
data.description: Once per day you can produce a burst of swirling white light that provides a measure of protection and renewal to allies within 30 feet for 1 round. On their turn, the allies can choose either to gain a +%1 sacred bonus to AC for 1 round or to heal a number of hit points equal to %1d6 + %2 (their choice). If an ally is dying, it is stabilized instead.|1+OracleLVL/7|CHA
